Lin: quick microtask — ran the nightly link-scan and found a 404 in the canary runbook (/runbooks/canary#step-2). Super small fix (replace shortlink -> canonical), can pair over lunch. @Priya @Samir any takers? Needs CR and a tiny changelog entry.
Priya: I can grab this after stand. ping me the exact path and the failing link pls.
Lin: path is content/runbooks/canary.md line ~84, broken shortlink: http://short.ly/ci-canary -> should be https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary#ci-canary
Lin: sed snippet I used to eyeball the section: ```sed -n '80,90p' content/runbooks/canary.md``` — happy to open PR now.
Samir: busy until 16:00 PT but can do CR after 16:15. will add to my queue. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll open a tiny PR now, branch `docs/canary-shortlink-fix`. will add `#docs` label and a one-line changelog in CHANGES.md.
docs-bot: link-scan: detected 1 broken link in content/runbooks/canary.md (auto-ticket #2315). please reference if you fix.
Lin: thanks! @Priya can you add the auto-ticket #2315 to the PR description? if not, I can.
Priya: done — PR 4823 opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — small sed change + changelog. requesting @Samir for review after 16:15.
Samir: LGTM pending tiny nit (trailing space in CHANGES.md). will approve after that edit. If anyone's free to push quick amend, go ahead.
Lin: I'll patch the nit in a follow-up commit. Thanks all :party_parrot:
Priya: awesome, thanks Lin & Samir. closing the microtask.
